all session states and transitions explicitly, replacing the nullable field approach (`streamId: number|null`, `meta: BeaconMeta|null`) that produces forgotten-transition bugs.\n4\t\n5\t**References:** plan.md §7.3, §7.6, §8.3, D22, D27, edge cases E8-E10, E12, E16\n6\t\n7\t---\n8\t\n9\t## Receiver Session State Machine\n10\t\n11\t### States Overview\n12\t\n13\tThe receiver has **10 primary states** grouped into three lifecycle phases:\n14\t\n15\t```\n16\t┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n17\t│ ACQUISITION PHASE                                               │\n18\t│  ┌─────────┐     ┌────────────┐     ┌──────────────┐            │\n19\t│  │ IDLE    │───▶  │ ACQUIRING  │───▶  │ RECEIVING    │            │\n20\t│  └─────────┘     └────────────┘     └──────────────┘            │\n21\t└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n22\t\n23\t┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n24\t│ COMPLETION PHASE                                               │\n25\t│  ┌──────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐     ┌───────────┐        │\n26\t│  │ RECEIVING    │───▶  │ VERIFYING   │───▶  │ COMPLETE  │        │\n27\t│  └──────────────┘     └─────────────┘     └───────────┘        │\n28\t└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n29\t\n30\t┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n31\t│ RECOVERY & ERROR PHASE                                         │\n32\t│  ┌──────────────┐     ┌──────────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐ │\n33\t│  │ PAUSED       │     │ REPAIR_WAITING   │     │ QUOTA_...   │ │\n34\t│  │              │◀───▶  │                  │     │ EXHAUSTED   │ │\n35\t│  └──────────────┘     └──────────────────┘     └─────────────┘ │\n36\t│                                                                  │\n37\t│  ┌──────────────────────────────┐                               │\n38\t│  │ DECOMPRESS_FAILED            │                               │\n39\t│  └──────────────────────────────┘                               │\n40\t└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n41\t```\n42\t\n43\t### Detailed State Specifications\n44\t\n45\t#### 1. IDLE\n46\t**Entry:** App initialization, session reset, or after export\n47\t**Exit:** User starts camera (`getUserMedia`)\n48\t\n49\t**Characteristics:**\n50\t- No session state persisted\n51\t- No camera active\n52\t- UI: Shows \"Start receiving\" or role selection\n53\t\n54\t**Invariants:**\n55\t- `streamId === null`\n56\t- `meta === null`\n57\t- `complete === new Uint8Array(0)` (empty bitmap)\n58\t\n59\t---\n60\t\n61\t#### 2. ACQUIRING\n62\t**Entry:** Camera started (`getUserMedia` success)\n63\t**Exit:** First valid beacon received\n64\t\n65\t**Characteristics:**\n66\t- Camera active, frame loop running\n67\t- Headers being decoded, but filtered by `streamId === null`\n68\t- UI: Shows \"acquiring...\" with live frame feedback\n69\t- Stalls detected: optical diagnostics (`E-NO-SIGNAL`, `E-TOO-FAR`, etc.)\n70\t\n71\t**State fields:**\n72\t```ts\n73\ttype AcquiringState = {\n74\t  type: 'acquiring',\n75\t  startTime: number,        // when camera started\n76\t  frameCount: number,        // for stall detection\n77\t  lastPacketTime: number,    // for optical stall detector\n78\t}\n79\t```\n80\t\n81\t**Transitions:**\n82\t- **→ RECEIVING**: Valid beacon arrives, `streamId` locked, `meta` parsed\n83\t- **→ PAUSED**: Camera permission revoked (E9) or camera track ends\n84\t- **→ IDLE**: User cancels, camera error\n85\t\n86\t**Invariants:**\n87\t- No packet routing occurs (no `streamId` to lock onto)\n88\t- Beacon validation is **strict** (T1 bounds checking)\n89\t\n90\t---\n91\t\n92\t#### 3. RECEIVING\n93\t**Entry:** First beacon parsed and accepted\n94\t**Exit:** All blocks collected (bitmap all 1s)\n95\t\n96\t**Characteristics:**\n97\t- Normal operation: collecting blocks\n98\t- GE decoder active on one block at a time (I5)\n99\t- OPFS writes occur per completed block\n100\t- UI: Progress bar, ETA, current rate\n101\t\n102\t**State fields:**\n103\t```ts\n104\ttype ReceivingState = {\n105\t  type: 'receiving',\n106\t  streamId: number,                    // locked, never changes\n107\t  meta: BeaconMeta,                    // immutable after beacon\n108\t  complete: Uint8Array,               // block bitmap\n109\t  writtenBlocks: Uint8Array,         // bitmap tracking blocks written to OPFS\n110\t  active: {                           // current payload block being decoded\n111\t    blockIndex: number,\n112\t    pivots: Map<number, GERow>,\n113\t    rank: number,\n114\t    consecutiveHigher: number,        // count of consecutive packets with higher blockIndex\n115\t    switchThreshold: number          // N consecutive packets to trigger block switch (default 32)\n116\t  } | null,                           // null = between payload blocks\n117\t  manifestActive: {                  // manifest block being decoded (bf-28b: I5 resolution)\n118\t    pivots: Map<number, GERow>,\n119\t    rank: number,\n120\t  } | null,                           // null = no manifest block active\n121\t  out: FileSystemWritableFileStream | null,\n122\t  manifest: BlockHashManifest | null,  // from §7.6\n123\t  stats: {\n124\t    fps: number,\n125\t    cameraPxPerModule: number,\n126\t    packetsPerSec: number,\n127\t    eta: number,\n128\t    dutyCycle: number,               // D27: 0.0–1.0\n129\t  }\n130\t}\n131\t```\n132\t\n133\t**Block-switch policy (bf-2t1k):**\n134\t- The receiver holds the current active block until: (1) block completion (rank === K), OR (2) N consecutive higher-index packets arrive (default N=32)\n135\t- This prevents discarding nearly-complete blocks when camera frames straddle sender block transitions\n136\t- See: `docs/notes/bf-2t1k-block-switch-policy.md`\n137\t\n138\t**Transitions:**\n139\t- **→ VERIFYING**: `bitmap.allSet()` && `manifest !== null`\n140\t- **→ PAUSED**: Camera lost (E9), tab backgrounded, or thermal duty-cycle (D27)\n141\t- **→ QUOTA_EXHAUSTED**: OPFS write fails (E10)\n142\t- **→ DECOMPRESS_FAILED**: Decompression error after all blocks verified (E15)\n143\t- **→ RECEIVING (self)**: Block hash fail (E12) → clear bitmap bit, re-collect\n144\t\n145\t**Sub-transitions within RECEIVING:**\n146\t- **Block completion**: `rank === K` → verify hash → write OPFS → set bitmap bit → free matrix\n147\t- **Block hash failure** (E12): Discard block, clear bitmap bit, restart collection\n148\t- **Worker crash** (E16): Restart worker, discard only the active block, preserve bitmap\n149\t\n150\t**Invariants:**\n151\t- `streamId` is **immutable** once locked (A9: wrong stream rejected)\n152\t- `meta` is **immutable** (gates all decode parameters)\n153\t- Exactly one **payload** block is GE-active at a time; the manifest stream has its own separate GE context (I5, bf-28b)\n154\t- Block writes to OPFS are **atomic** (hash verification first)\n155\t\n156\t---\n157\t\n158\t### I5 Resolution: Dual GE Contexts (bf-28b)\n159\t\n160\t**Why two separate GE contexts:**\n161\t\n162\tThe manifest (§7.6) requires its own GE context running concurrently with payload blocks because:\n163\t1. The manifest is fountain-coded with K=768 (same as payload blocks)\n164\t2. Manifest blocks are **interleaved** with payload blocks on the same schedule as the beacon\n165\t3. The manifest uses reserved `blockIndex = 0xFFFFFF` and `PacketFlags.Manifest`\n166\t4. Both require concurrent fountain decoding\n167\t\n168\t**Implementation:**\n169\t\n170\tRather than serializing manifest acquisition (which would contradict the interleaved design), I5 was amended to permit two concurrent GE contexts:\n171\t- `active`: GE decoder state for current payload block (null if no block active)\n172\t- `manifestActive`: GE decoder state for manifest block (null if no manifest block active)\n173\t\n174\t**Memory impact:**\n175\t- Adds at most 72 KB (one GE decoder) for manifest decoding — within I6a's 1 MB budget\n176\t\n177\t**See:** `notes/bf-28b-manifest-ge-context-resolution.md` for full analysis\n178\t\n179\t---\n180\t\n181\t---\n182\t\n183\t#### 4. VERIFYING\n184\t**Entry:** All blocks collected, manifest stream decoded\n185\t**Exit:** All blocks verified against manifest hashes\n186\t\n187\t**Characteristics:**\n188\t- All blocks technically received, but retroactively verified\n189\t- UI: Shows \"verifying...\" (not \"complete\" yet)\n190\t- Occurs when manifest (blockIndex = 0xFFFFFF) decodes\n191\t\n192\t**State fields:**\n193\t```ts\n194\ttype VerifyingState = {\n195\t  type: 'verifying',\n196\t  streamId: number,\n197\t  meta: BeaconMeta,\n198\t  complete: Uint8Array,              // bitmap: all blocks marked received\n199\t  out: FileSystemWritableFileStream,\n200\t  manifest: BlockHashManifest,       // now decoded\n201\t  verificationProgress: {\n202\t    verified: number,\n203\t    total: number,\n204\t    failedBlocks: number[]          // blocks that failed hash\n205\t  }\n206\t}\n207\t```\n208\t\n209\t**Transitions:**\n210\t- **→ COMPLETE**: All blocks verified successfully\n211\t- **→ RECEIVING**: Some blocks failed hash → clear those bits, re-collect (E12 extended)\n212\t- **→ DECOMPRESS_FAILED**: All blocks verified, but decompression fails (E15)\n213\t\n214\t**Invariants:**\n215\t- No OPFS writes occur during verification\n216\t- Blocks are re-verified, not trusted (D22: resume MUST re-verify)\n217\t\n218\t---\n219\t\n220\t#### 5. COMPLETE\n221\t**Entry:** All blocks verified and (if compressed) decompressed\n222\t**Exit:** User exports file or app closes\n223\t\n224\t**Characteristics:**\n225\t- File ready for export\n226\t- UI: Shows \"Complete\" with export/share button\n227\t\n228\t**State fields:**\n229\t```ts\n230\ttype CompleteState = {\n231\t  type: 'complete',\n232\t  streamId: number,\n233\t  meta: BeaconMeta,\n234\t  outputPath: string,                // OPFS file path\n235\t  outputSize: number,\n236\t  verified: boolean,\n237\t  compressed: boolean\n238\t}\n239\t```\n240\t\n241\t**Transitions:**\n242\t- **→ IDLE**: Export successful, session cleared\n243\t\n244\t**Invariants:**\n245\t- File exists in OPFS\n246\t- Whole-file hash (if present) has been validated\n247\t\n248\t---\n249\t\n250\t#### 6. PAUSED\n251\t**Entry:** Camera lost, tab backgrounded, or thermal duty-cycle\n252\t**Exit:** Camera re-acquired, user resumes, or transfer abandoned\n253\t\n254\t**Characteristics:**\n255\t- Session state preserved (bitmap, meta)\n256\t- Camera may be off or frame loop suspended\n257\t- UI: Shows \"Paused\" with resume option\n258\t\n259\t**State fields:**\n260\t```ts\n261\ttype PausedState = {\n262\t  type: 'paused',\n263\t  previousState: ReceivingState,    // frozen state\n264\t  pauseReason: 'camera-lost' | 'tab-backgrounded' | 'thermal',\n265\t  pauseTime: number\n266\t}\n267\t```\n268\t\n269\t**Transitions:**\n270\t- **→ RECEIVING**: Camera re-acquired (user grants permission again)\n271\t- **→ RECEIVING**: Tab foregrounded again (E8)\n272\t- **→ IDLE**: User abandons transfer\n273\t\n274\t**Invariants:**\n275\t- `bitmap` is preserved (no blocks lost)\n276\t- `meta` and `streamId` unchanged\n277\t- **No new packets are decoded** but progress is retained\n278\t\n279\t---\n280\t\n281\t#### 7. REPAIR_WAITING\n282\t**Entry:** User invoked repair code flow (some blocks missing)\n283\t**Exit:** Valid repair code entered\n284\t\n285\t**Characteristics:**\n286\t- Transfer incomplete but user has chosen repair path\n287\t- UI: Shows repair code input field\n288\t\n289\t**State fields:**\n290\t```ts\n291\ttype RepairWaitingState = {\n292\t  type: 'repair-waiting',\n293\t  streamId: number,\n294\t  meta: BeaconMeta,\n295\t  complete: Uint8Array,              // partial bitmap\n296\t  missingBlocks: number[],          // derived from bitmap\n297\t  repairCode: string | null\n298\t}\n299\t```\n300\t\n301\t**Transitions:**\n302\t- **→ REPAIR_TRANSFERRING**: Valid repair code entered\n303\t- **→ RECEIVING**: User cancels repair, returns to normal collection\n304\t\n305\t**Invariants:**\n306\t- Bitmap is **not modified** during repair wait\n307\t\n308\t---\n309\t\n310\t#### 8. REPAIR_TRANSFERRING\n311\t**Entry:** Valid repair code parsed\n312\t**Exit:** All missing blocks received\n313\t\n314\t**Characteristics:**\n315\t- Sender is transmitting only the missing blocks\n316\t- Receiver is in a special mode expecting only those blocks\n317\t- UI: Shows repair progress\n318\t\n319\t**State fields:**\n320\t```ts\n321\ttype RepairTransferringState = {\n322\t  type: 'repair-transferring',\n323\t  streamId: number,\n324\t  meta: BeaconMeta,\n325\t  complete: Uint8Array,\n326\t  expectedBlocks: Set<number>,       // only these blocks accepted\n327\t  receivedCount: number\n328\t}\n329\t```\n330\t\n331\t**Transitions:**\n332\t- **→ VERIFYING**: All expected blocks received\n333\t- **→ REPAIR_WAITING**: Some blocks still missing after timeout\n334\t\n335\t**Invariants:**\n336\t- **Only packets in the expected set are accepted**\n337\t- Other packets are logged but discarded (E-FOREIGN-STREAM)\n338\t\n339\t---\n340\t\n341\t#### 9. QUOTA_EXHAUSTED\n342\t**Entry:** OPFS quota check fails during RECEIVING (E10)\n343\t**Exit:** Partial file exported or user clears space\n344\t\n345\t**Characteristics:**\n346\t- Transfer cannot continue\n347\t- Partial file is kept (follows T4b lifecycle)\n348\t- UI: Shows quota exhausted with partial export option\n349\t\n350\t**State fields:**\n351\t```ts\n352\ttype QuotaExhaustedState = {\n353\t  type: 'quota-exhausted',\n354\t  streamId: number,\n355\t  meta: BeaconMeta,\n356\t  complete: Uint8Array,              // partial bitmap\n357\t  partialOutputPath: string,\n358\t  missingBlocks: number[]\n359\t}\n360\t```\n361\t\n362\t**Transitions:**\n363\t- **→ IDLE**: Partial file exported, session ends\n364\t\n365\t**Invariants:**\n366\t- **No silent truncation** (E10)\n367\t- User is warned before keeping partial artefact\n368\t- Partial file follows T4b deletion lifecycle\n369\t\n370\t---\n371\t\n372\t#### 10. DECOMPRESS_FAILED\n373\t**Entry:** All blocks verified, but decompression fails (E15)\n374\t**Exit:** User handles failure or keeps raw artefact\n375\t\n376\t**Characteristics:**\n377\t- Blocks verified, but gzip stream invalid\n378\t- Compressed artefact is kept\n379\t- UI: Shows decompression failed, keeps raw data\n380\t\n381\t**State fields:**\n382\t```ts\n383\ttype DecompressFailedState = {\n384\t  type: 'decompress-failed',\n385\t  streamId: number,\n386\t  meta: BeaconMeta,\n387\t  compressedOutputPath: string,\n388\t  error: string\n389\t}\n390\t```\n391\t\n392\t**Transitions:**\n393\t- **→ IDLE**: User acknowledges, raw artefact kept\n394\t\n395\t**Invariants:**\n396\t- Raw (compressed) artefact is preserved\n397\t- Follows T4b deletion lifecycle\n398\t- No data is lost\n399\t\n400\t---\n401\t\n402\t### Receiver State Transitions Summary\n403\t\n404\t| From State | To State | Trigger | Action |\n405\t|---|---|---|---|\n406\t| IDLE | ACQUIRING | User starts camera | `getUserMedia()` |\n407\t| ACQUIRING | RECEIVING | First valid beacon | Lock streamId, parse meta |\n408\t| ACQUIRING | PAUSED | Camera lost | Preserve state, await re-grant |\n409\t| ACQUIRING | IDLE | User cancels / error | Release camera |\n410\t| RECEIVING | VERIFYING | All blocks collected, manifest decoded | Begin hash verification |\n411\t| RECEIVING | PAUSED | Camera lost / thermal | Preserve state |\n412\t| RECEIVING | QUOTA_EXHAUSTED | OPFS quota exhausted (E10) | Stop, export partial |\n413\t| RECEIVING | RECEIVING | Block hash fail (E12) | Clear bitmap bit, re-collect |\n414\t| RECEIVING | RECEIVING | Worker crash (E16) | Restart worker, discard active block |\n415\t| VERIFYING | COMPLETE | All blocks verified | Prepare export |\n416\t| VERIFYING | RECEIVING | Some blocks failed hash | Clear failed bits, re-collect |\n417\t| VERIFYING | DECOMPRESS_FAILED | Decompression error (E15) | Keep compressed artefact |\n418\t| PAUSED | RECEIVING | Camera re-acquired / foregrounded | Resume with preserved state |\n419\t| PAUSED | IDLE | User abandons | Clear session |\n420\t| REPAIR_WAITING | REPAIR_TRANSFERRING | Valid repair code entered | Accept only expected blocks |\n421\t| REPAIR_TRANSFERRING | VERIFYING | All expected blocks received | Verify and complete |\n422\t| QUOTA_EXHAUSTED | IDLE | Partial export complete | Clear session, warn user |\n423\t| DECOMPRESS_FAILED | IDLE | User acknowledges | Keep artefact, clear session |\n424\t\n425\t---\n426\t\n427\t## Sender Session State Machine\n428\t\n429\t### States Overview\n430\t\n431\tThe sender has **6 primary states**:\n432\t\n433\t```\n434\t┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n435\t│  ┌─────────┐     ┌──────────┐     ┌─────────────┐      │\n436\t│  │ IDLE    │───▶  │ SENDING  │───▶  │ PAUSED      │      │\n437\t│  └─────────┘     └──────────┘     └─────────────┘      │\n438\t└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n439\t\n440\t┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n441\t│  ┌─────────────┐     ┌──────────────┐     ┌─────────┐  │\n442\t│  │ REPAIR_MODE │───▶  │ STOPPING     │───▶  │ IDLE    │  │\n443\t│  └─────────────┘     └──────────────┘     └─────────┘  │\n444\t└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n445\t```\n446\t\n447\t### Detailed State Specifications\n448\t\n449\t#### 1. IDLE\n450\t**Entry:** App initialization, transfer complete, or cancel\n451\t**Exit:** User selects file and starts sending\n452\t\n453\t**Characteristics:**\n454\t- No file selected\n455\t- No active session\n456\t- UI: Shows \"Send file\" button\n457\t\n458\t**State fields:**\n459\t```ts\n460\ttype IdleState = {\n461\t  type: 'idle'\n462\t}\n463\t```\n464\t\n465\t---\n466\t\n467\t#### 2. SENDING\n468\t**Entry:** File selected, compression (if enabled) complete, first frame rendered\n469\t**Exit:** User stops, tab backgrounded, or file change detected\n470\t\n471\t**Characteristics:**\n472\t- Frame loop running at ≤½ measured camera fps (D9)\n473\t- Blocks emitted cyclically with dwell (§8.1)\n474\t- Beacons emitted every ~2 seconds (D17)\n475\t- Stateless sender: frame N generated on-demand without replaying 1…N−1 (D24)\n476\t\n477\t**State fields:**\n478\t```ts\n479\ttype SendingState = {\n480\t  type: 'sending',\n481\t  source: File,\n482\t  staging: FileSystemFileHandle | null,  // compressed copy (D8), wiped on complete\n483\t  streamId: number,                      // derived §7.4\n484\t  blockSize: number,                   // 192 KB\n485\t  blockCount: number,\n486\t  readonly fragmentLen: number,         // L (I1: immutable)\n487\t  readonly K: number,                   // D26\n488\t  cursor: {\n489\t    blockIndex: number,\n490\t    seq: number                         // within block\n491\t  },\n492\t  dwellPackets: number,                 // §8.1: 1.6K default\n493\t  lastFrameEmitted: number,\n494\t  sourceFingerprint: {\n495\t    size: number,\n496\t    lastModified: number\n497\t  }\n498\t}\n499\t```\n500\t\n501\t**Transitions:**\n502\t- **→ PAUSED**: Tab backgrounded (E8, visibilitychange)\n503\t- **→ REPAIR_MODE**: User enters repair code from receiver\n504\t- **→ STOPPING**: User cancels, file changed (E5), or staging error\n505\t- **→ SENDING (self)**: Source file change detected (E5) → abort with E-SOURCE-CHANGED\n506\t\n507\t**Sub-transitions within SENDING:**\n508\t- **Frame loop**: Generate frame → render → sleep to meet fps target → repeat\n509\t- **Beacon emission**: Every ~2 seconds, emit beacon at conservative profile\n510\t- **Source change detection** (E5): Re-check `file.size` and `lastModified` before each block read\n511\t\n512\t**Invariants:**\n513\t- `L` is **immutable** (I1)\n514\t- Frames are generated on-demand, never pre-rendered (I7)\n515\t- Ring buffer depth ≤ 3 (I7)\n516\t\n517\t---\n518\t\n519\t#### 3. PAUSED\n520\t**Entry:** Tab backgrounded (E8)\n521\t**Exit:** Tab foregrounded\n522\t\n523\t**Characteristics:**\n524\t- `rAF` stopped, frame loop suspended\n525\t- State preserved\n526\t- UI: Shows \"Sending paused — keep this tab visible\" (E-BACKGROUNDED)\n527\t\n528\t**State fields:**\n529\t```ts\n530\ttype PausedSenderState = {\n531\t  type: 'paused',\n532\t  previousState: SendingState,\n533\t  pauseTime: number\n534\t}\n535\t```\n536\t\n537\t**Transitions:**\n538\t- **→ SENDING**: Tab foregrounded (visibilitychange)\n539\t\n540\t**Invariants:**\n541\t- State unchanged, can resume seamlessly\n542\t- **Wake Lock does not cover background tabs** (E8), so pause is necessary\n543\t\n544\t---\n545\t\n546\t#### 4. REPAIR_MODE\n547\t**Entry:** User enters repair code from receiver\n548\t**Exit:** Missing blocks sent\n549\t\n550\t**Characteristics:**\n551\t- Sender transmits **only** the blocks specified in repair code\n552\t- Normal dwell and beacons still apply\n553\t- UI: Shows repair progress\n554\t\n555\t**State fields:**\n556\t```ts\n557\ttype RepairModeState = {\n558\t  type: 'repair-mode',\n559\t  baseState: SendingState,\n560\t  targetBlocks: Set<number>,           // only these blocks emitted\n561\t  emittedCount: number,\n562\t  totalTarget: number\n563\t}\n564\t```\n565\t\n566\t**Transitions:**\n567\t- **→ SENDING**: Repair complete, return to normal loop\n568\t- **→ STOPPING**: User cancels\n569\t\n570\t**Invariants:**\n571\t- **Only blocks in target set are emitted**\n572\t- Other block indices are skipped in the loop\n573\t\n574\t---\n575\t\n576\t#### 5. STOPPING\n577\t**Entry:** User cancels or error condition\n578\t**Exit:** Cleanup complete, back to IDLE\n579\t\n580\t**Characteristics:**\n581\t- Graceful shutdown: wipe staging file (D8, T4a)\n582\t- Frame loop stopped\n583\t- Resources released\n584\t\n585\t**State fields:**\n586\t```ts\n587\ttype StoppingState = {\n588\t  type: 'stopping',\n589\t  reason: 'user-cancel' | 'source-changed' | 'error',\n590\t  previousState: SendingState | RepairModeState\n591\t}\n592\t```\n593\t\n594\t**Transitions:**\n595\t- **→ IDLE**: Cleanup complete\n596\t\n597\t**Actions:**\n598\t- Wipe staging file (D8, T4a, E11)\n599\t- Close file handles\n600\t- Release camera/render resources\n601\t\n602\t---\n603\t\n604\t#### 6. COMPLETE\n605\t**Note:** The sender has **no COMPLETE state**. The sender cannot know when the receiver is done (no back-channel). The sender loops forever until explicitly stopped.\n606\t\n607\t---\n608\t\n609\t### Sender State Transitions Summary\n610\t\n611\t| From State | To State | Trigger | Action |\n612\t|---|---|---|---|\n613\t| IDLE | SENDING | User selects file, starts send | Compress (if enabled), derive streamId, start frame loop |\n614\t| SENDING | PAUSED | Tab backgrounded (E8) | Stop handleRepairPacket(state, packet);\n684\t      }\n685\t      return state;\n686\t    // ...\n687\t  }\n688\t}\n689\t```\n690\t\n691\t**Transition validation:**\n692\t```ts\n693\tfunction Session State Machine Specification\n\n**Purpose:** Define all session states and transitions explicitly, replacing the nullable field approach (`streamId: number|null`, `meta: BeaconMeta|null`) that produces forgotten-transition bugs.\n\n**References:** plan.md §7.3, §7.6, §8.3, D22, D27, edge cases E8-E10, E12, E16\n\n---\n\n## Receiver Session State Machine\n\n### States Overview\n\nThe receiver has **10 primary states** grouped into three lifecycle phases:\n\n```\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│ ACQUISITION PHASE                                               │\n│  ┌─────────┐     ┌────────────┐     ┌──────────────┐            │\n│  │ IDLE    │───▶  │ ACQUIRING  │───▶  │ RECEIVING    │            │\n│  └─────────┘     └────────────┘     └──────────────┘            │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│ COMPLETION PHASE                                               │\n│  ┌──────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐     ┌───────────┐        │\n│  │ RECEIVING    │───▶  │ VERIFYING   │───▶  │ COMPLETE  │        │\n│  └──────────────┘     └─────────────┘     └───────────┘        │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│ RECOVERY & ERROR PHASE                                         │\n│  ┌──────────────┐     ┌──────────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐ │\n│  │ PAUSED       │     │ REPAIR_WAITING   │     │ QUOTA_...   │ │\n│  │              │◀───▶  │                  │     │ EXHAUSTED   │ │\n│  └──────────────┘     └──────────────────┘     └─────────────┘ │\n│                                                                  │\n│  ┌──────────────────────────────┐                               │\n│  │ DECOMPRESS_FAILED            │                               │\n│  └──────────────────────────────┘                               │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### Detailed State Specifications\n\n#### 1. IDLE\n**Entry:** App initialization, session reset, or after export\n**Exit:** User starts camera (`getUserMedia`)\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- No session state persisted\n- No camera active\n- UI: Shows \"Start receiving\" or role selection\n\n**Invariants:**\n- `streamId === null`\n- `meta === null`\n- `complete === new Uint8Array(0)` (empty bitmap)\n\n---\n\n#### 2. ACQUIRING\n**Entry:** Camera started (`getUserMedia` success)\n**Exit:** First valid beacon received\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Camera active, frame loop running\n- Headers being decoded, but filtered by `streamId === null`\n- UI: Shows \"acquiring...\" with live frame feedback\n- Stalls detected: optical diagnostics (`E-NO-SIGNAL`, `E-TOO-FAR`, etc.)\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype AcquiringState = {\n  type: 'acquiring',\n  startTime: number,        // when camera started\n  frameCount: number,        // for stall detection\n  lastPacketTime: number,    // for optical stall detector\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ RECEIVING**: Valid beacon arrives, `streamId` locked, `meta` parsed\n- **→ PAUSED**: Camera permission revoked (E9) or camera track ends\n- **→ IDLE**: User cancels, camera error\n\n**Invariants:**\n- No packet routing occurs (no `streamId` to lock onto)\n- Beacon validation is **strict** (T1 bounds checking)\n\n---\n\n#### 3. RECEIVING\n**Entry:** First beacon parsed and accepted\n**Exit:** All blocks collected (bitmap all 1s)\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Normal operation: collecting blocks\n- GE decoder active on one block at a time (I5)\n- OPFS writes occur per completed block\n- UI: Progress bar, ETA, current rate\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype ReceivingState = {\n  type: 'receiving',\n  streamId: number,                    // locked, never changes\n  meta: BeaconMeta,                    // immutable after beacon\n  complete: Uint8Array,               // block bitmap\n  writtenBlocks: Uint8Array,         // bitmap tracking blocks written to OPFS\n  active: {                           // current payload block being decoded\n    blockIndex: number,\n    pivots: Map<number, GERow>,\n    rank: number,\n    consecutiveHigher: number,        // count of consecutive packets with higher blockIndex\n    switchThreshold: number          // N consecutive packets to trigger block switch (default 32)\n  } | null,                           // null = between payload blocks\n  manifestActive: {                  // manifest block being decoded (bf-28b: I5 resolution)\n    pivots: Map<number, GERow>,\n    rank: number,\n  } | null,                           // null = no manifest block active\n  out: FileSystemWritableFileStream | null,\n  manifest: BlockHashManifest | null,  // from §7.6\n  stats: {\n    fps: number,\n    cameraPxPerModule: number,\n    packetsPerSec: number,\n    eta: number,\n    dutyCycle: number,               // D27: 0.0–1.0\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**Block-switch policy (bf-2t1k):**\n- The receiver holds the current active block until: (1) block completion (rank === K), OR (2) N consecutive higher-index packets arrive (default N=32)\n- This prevents discarding nearly-complete blocks when camera frames straddle sender block transitions\n- See: `docs/notes/bf-2t1k-block-switch-policy.md`\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ VERIFYING**: `bitmap.allSet()` && `manifest !== null`\n- **→ PAUSED**: Camera lost (E9), tab backgrounded, or thermal duty-cycle (D27)\n- **→ QUOTA_EXHAUSTED**: OPFS write fails (E10)\n- **→ DECOMPRESS_FAILED**: Decompression error after all blocks verified (E15)\n- **→ RECEIVING (self)**: Block hash fail (E12) → clear bitmap bit, re-collect\n\n**Sub-transitions within RECEIVING:**\n- **Block completion**: `rank === K` → verify hash → write OPFS → set bitmap bit → free matrix\n- **Block hash failure** (E12): Discard block, clear bitmap bit, restart collection\n- **Worker crash** (E16): Restart worker, discard only the active block, preserve bitmap\n\n**Invariants:**\n- `streamId` is **immutable** once locked (A9: wrong stream rejected)\n- `meta` is **immutable** (gates all decode parameters)\n- Exactly one **payload** block is GE-active at a time; the manifest stream has its own separate GE context (I5, bf-28b)\n- Block writes to OPFS are **atomic** (hash verification first)\n\n---\n\n### I5 Resolution: Dual GE Contexts (bf-28b)\n\n**Why two separate GE contexts:**\n\nThe manifest (§7.6) requires its own GE context running concurrently with payload blocks because:\n1. The manifest is fountain-coded with K=768 (same as payload blocks)\n2. Manifest blocks are **interleaved** with payload blocks on the same schedule as the beacon\n3. The manifest uses reserved `blockIndex = 0xFFFFFF` and `PacketFlags.Manifest`\n4. Both require concurrent fountain decoding\n\n**Implementation:**\n\nRather than serializing manifest acquisition (which would contradict the interleaved design), I5 was amended to permit two concurrent GE contexts:\n- `active`: GE decoder state for current payload block (null if no block active)\n- `manifestActive`: GE decoder state for manifest block (null if no manifest block active)\n\n**Memory impact:**\n- Adds at most 72 KB (one GE decoder) for manifest decoding — within I6a's 1 MB budget\n\n**See:** `notes/bf-28b-manifest-ge-context-resolution.md` for full analysis\n\n---\n\n---\n\n#### 4. VERIFYING\n**Entry:** All blocks collected, manifest stream decoded\n**Exit:** All blocks verified against manifest hashes\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- All blocks technically received, but retroactively verified\n- UI: Shows \"verifying...\" (not \"complete\" yet)\n- Occurs when manifest (blockIndex = 0xFFFFFF) decodes\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype VerifyingState = {\n  type: 'verifying',\n  streamId: number,\n  meta: BeaconMeta,\n  complete: Uint8Array,              // bitmap: all blocks marked received\n  out: FileSystemWritableFileStream,\n  manifest: BlockHashManifest,       // now decoded\n  verificationProgress: {\n    verified: number,\n    total: number,\n    failedBlocks: number[]          // blocks that failed hash\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ COMPLETE**: All blocks verified successfully\n- **→ RECEIVING**: Some blocks failed hash → clear those bits, re-collect (E12 extended)\n- **→ DECOMPRESS_FAILED**: All blocks verified, but decompression fails (E15)\n\n**Invariants:**\n- No OPFS writes occur during verification\n- Blocks are re-verified, not trusted (D22: resume MUST re-verify)\n\n---\n\n#### 5. COMPLETE\n**Entry:** All blocks verified and (if compressed) decompressed\n**Exit:** User exports file or app closes\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- File ready for export\n- UI: Shows \"Complete\" with export/share button\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype CompleteState = {\n  type: 'complete',\n  streamId: number,\n  meta: BeaconMeta,\n  outputPath: string,                // OPFS file path\n  outputSize: number,\n  verified: boolean,\n  compressed: boolean\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ IDLE**: Export successful, session cleared\n\n**Invariants:**\n- File exists in OPFS\n- Whole-file hash (if present) has been validated\n\n---\n\n#### 6. PAUSED\n**Entry:** Camera lost, tab backgrounded, or thermal duty-cycle\n**Exit:** Camera re-acquired, user resumes, or transfer abandoned\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Session state preserved (bitmap, meta)\n- Camera may be off or frame loop suspended\n- UI: Shows \"Paused\" with resume option\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype PausedState = {\n  type: 'paused',\n  previousState: ReceivingState,    // frozen state\n  pauseReason: 'camera-lost' | 'tab-backgrounded' | 'thermal',\n  pauseTime: number\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ RECEIVING**: Camera re-acquired (user grants permission again)\n- **→ RECEIVING**: Tab foregrounded again (E8)\n- **→ IDLE**: User abandons transfer\n\n**Invariants:**\n- `bitmap` is preserved (no blocks lost)\n- `meta` and `streamId` unchanged\n- **No new packets are decoded** but progress is retained\n\n---\n\n#### 7. REPAIR_WAITING\n**Entry:** User invoked repair code flow (some blocks missing)\n**Exit:** Valid repair code entered\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Transfer incomplete but user has chosen repair path\n- UI: Shows repair code input field\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype RepairWaitingState = {\n  type: 'repair-waiting',\n  streamId: number,\n  meta: BeaconMeta,\n  complete: Uint8Array,              // partial bitmap\n  missingBlocks: number[],          // derived from bitmap\n  repairCode: string | null\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ REPAIR_TRANSFERRING**: Valid repair code entered\n- **→ RECEIVING**: User cancels repair, returns to normal collection\n\n**Invariants:**\n- Bitmap is **not modified** during repair wait\n\n---\n\n#### 8. REPAIR_TRANSFERRING\n**Entry:** Valid repair code parsed\n**Exit:** All missing blocks received\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Sender is transmitting only the missing blocks\n- Receiver is in a special mode expecting only those blocks\n- UI: Shows repair progress\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype RepairTransferringState = {\n  type: 'repair-transferring',\n  streamId: number,\n  meta: BeaconMeta,\n  complete: Uint8Array,\n  expectedBlocks: Set<number>,       // only these blocks accepted\n  receivedCount: number\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ VERIFYING**: All expected blocks received\n- **→ REPAIR_WAITING**: Some blocks still missing after timeout\n\n**Invariants:**\n- **Only packets in the expected set are accepted**\n- Other packets are logged but discarded (E-FOREIGN-STREAM)\n\n---\n\n#### 9. QUOTA_EXHAUSTED\n**Entry:** OPFS quota check fails during RECEIVING (E10)\n**Exit:** Partial file exported or user clears space\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Transfer cannot continue\n- Partial file is kept (follows T4b lifecycle)\n- UI: Shows quota exhausted with partial export option\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype QuotaExhaustedState = {\n  type: 'quota-exhausted',\n  streamId: number,\n  meta: BeaconMeta,\n  complete: Uint8Array,              // partial bitmap\n  partialOutputPath: string,\n  missingBlocks: number[]\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ IDLE**: Partial file exported, session ends\n\n**Invariants:**\n- **No silent truncation** (E10)\n- User is warned before keeping partial artefact\n- Partial file follows T4b deletion lifecycle\n\n---\n\n#### 10. DECOMPRESS_FAILED\n**Entry:** All blocks verified, but decompression fails (E15)\n**Exit:** User handles failure or keeps raw artefact\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Blocks verified, but gzip stream invalid\n- Compressed artefact is kept\n- UI: Shows decompression failed, keeps raw data\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype DecompressFailedState = {\n  type: 'decompress-failed',\n  streamId: number,\n  meta: BeaconMeta,\n  compressedOutputPath: string,\n  error: string\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ IDLE**: User acknowledges, raw artefact kept\n\n**Invariants:**\n- Raw (compressed) artefact is preserved\n- Follows T4b deletion lifecycle\n- No data is lost\n\n---\n\n### Receiver State Transitions Summary\n\n| From State | To State | Trigger | Action |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| IDLE | ACQUIRING | User starts camera | `getUserMedia()` |\n| ACQUIRING | RECEIVING | First valid beacon | Lock streamId, parse meta |\n| ACQUIRING | PAUSED | Camera lost | Preserve state, await re-grant |\n| ACQUIRING | IDLE | User cancels / error | Release camera |\n| RECEIVING | VERIFYING | All blocks collected, manifest decoded | Begin hash verification |\n| RECEIVING | PAUSED | Camera lost / thermal | Preserve state |\n| RECEIVING | QUOTA_EXHAUSTED | OPFS quota exhausted (E10) | Stop, export partial |\n| RECEIVING | RECEIVING | Block hash fail (E12) | Clear bitmap bit, re-collect |\n| RECEIVING | RECEIVING | Worker crash (E16) | Restart worker, discard active block |\n| VERIFYING | COMPLETE | All blocks verified | Prepare export |\n| VERIFYING | RECEIVING | Some blocks failed hash | Clear failed bits, re-collect |\n| VERIFYING | DECOMPRESS_FAILED | Decompression error (E15) | Keep compressed artefact |\n| PAUSED | RECEIVING | Camera re-acquired / foregrounded | Resume with preserved state |\n| PAUSED | IDLE | User abandons | Clear session |\n| REPAIR_WAITING | REPAIR_TRANSFERRING | Valid repair code entered | Accept only expected blocks |\n| REPAIR_TRANSFERRING | VERIFYING | All expected blocks received | Verify and complete |\n| QUOTA_EXHAUSTED | IDLE | Partial export complete | Clear session, warn user |\n| DECOMPRESS_FAILED | IDLE | User acknowledges | Keep artefact, clear session |\n\n---\n\n## Sender Session State Machine\n\n### States Overview\n\nThe sender has **6 primary states**:\n\n```\n┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│  ┌─────────┐     ┌──────────┐     ┌─────────────┐      │\n│  │ IDLE    │───▶  │ SENDING  │───▶  │ PAUSED      │      │\n│  └─────────┘     └──────────┘     └─────────────┘      │\n└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n\n┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│  ┌─────────────┐     ┌──────────────┐     ┌─────────┐  │\n│  │ REPAIR_MODE │───▶  │ STOPPING     │───▶  │ IDLE    │  │\n│  └─────────────┘     └──────────────┘     └─────────┘  │\n└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### Detailed State Specifications\n\n#### 1. IDLE\n**Entry:** App initialization, transfer complete, or cancel\n**Exit:** User selects file and starts sending\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- No file selected\n- No active session\n- UI: Shows \"Send file\" button\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype IdleState = {\n  type: 'idle'\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n#### 2. SENDING\n**Entry:** File selected, compression (if enabled) complete, first frame rendered\n**Exit:** User stops, tab backgrounded, or file change detected\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Frame loop running at ≤½ measured camera fps (D9)\n- Blocks emitted cyclically with dwell (§8.1)\n- Beacons emitted every ~2 seconds (D17)\n- Stateless sender: frame N generated on-demand without replaying 1…N−1 (D24)\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype SendingState = {\n  type: 'sending',\n  source: File,\n  staging: FileSystemFileHandle | null,  // compressed copy (D8), wiped on complete\n  streamId: number,                      // derived §7.4\n  blockSize: number,                   // 192 KB\n  blockCount: number,\n  readonly fragmentLen: number,         // L (I1: immutable)\n  readonly K: number,                   // D26\n  cursor: {\n    blockIndex: number,\n    seq: number                         // within block\n  },\n  dwellPackets: number,                 // §8.1: 1.6K default\n  lastFrameEmitted: number,\n  sourceFingerprint: {\n    size: number,\n    lastModified: number\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ PAUSED**: Tab backgrounded (E8, visibilitychange)\n- **→ REPAIR_MODE**: User enters repair code from receiver\n- **→ STOPPING**: User cancels, file changed (E5), or staging error\n- **→ SENDING (self)**: Source file change detected (E5) → abort with E-SOURCE-CHANGED\n\n**Sub-transitions within SENDING:**\n- **Frame loop**: Generate frame → render → sleep to meet fps target → repeat\n- **Beacon emission**: Every ~2 seconds, emit beacon at conservative profile\n- **Source change detection** (E5): Re-check `file.size` and `lastModified` before each block read\n\n**Invariants:**\n- `L` is **immutable** (I1)\n- Frames are generated on-demand, never pre-rendered (I7)\n- Ring buffer depth ≤ 3 (I7)\n\n---\n\n#### 3. PAUSED\n**Entry:** Tab backgrounded (E8)\n**Exit:** Tab foregrounded\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- `rAF` stopped, frame loop suspended\n- State preserved\n- UI: Shows \"Sending paused — keep this tab visible\" (E-BACKGROUNDED)\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype PausedSenderState = {\n  type: 'paused',\n  previousState: SendingState,\n  pauseTime: number\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ SENDING**: Tab foregrounded (visibilitychange)\n\n**Invariants:**\n- State unchanged, can resume seamlessly\n- **Wake Lock does not cover background tabs** (E8), so pause is necessary\n\n---\n\n#### 4. REPAIR_MODE\n**Entry:** User enters repair code from receiver\n**Exit:** Missing blocks sent\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Sender transmits **only** the blocks specified in repair code\n- Normal dwell and beacons still apply\n- UI: Shows repair progress\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype RepairModeState = {\n  type: 'repair-mode',\n  baseState: SendingState,\n  targetBlocks: Set<number>,           // only these blocks emitted\n  emittedCount: number,\n  totalTarget: number\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ SENDING**: Repair complete, return to normal loop\n- **→ STOPPING**: User cancels\n\n**Invariants:**\n- **Only blocks in target set are emitted**\n- Other block indices are skipped in the loop\n\n---\n\n#### 5. STOPPING\n**Entry:** User cancels or error condition\n**Exit:** Cleanup complete, back to IDLE\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Graceful shutdown: wipe staging file (D8, T4a)\n- Frame loop stopped\n- Resources released\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype StoppingState = {\n  type: 'stopping',\n  reason: 'user-cancel' | 'source-changed' | 'error',\n  previousState: SendingState | RepairModeState\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ IDLE**: Cleanup complete\n\n**Actions:**\n- Wipe staging file (D8, T4a, E11)\n- Close file handles\n- Release camera/render resources\n\n---\n\n#### 6. COMPLETE\n**Note:** The sender has **no COMPLETE state**. The sender cannot know when the receiver is done (no back-channel). The sender loops forever until explicitly stopped.\n\n---\n\n### Sender State Transitions Summary\n\n| From State | To State | Trigger | Action |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| IDLE | SENDING | User selects file, starts send | Compress (if enabled), derive streamId, start frame loop |\n| SENDING | PAUSED | Tab backgrounded (E8) | Stop frame loop, preserve state |\n| SENDING | REPAIR_MODE | Repair code entered | Restrict emission to target blocks |\n| SENDING | STOPPING | User cancel / source changed (E5) | Begin graceful shutdown |\n| SENDING | SENDING | Source change detected (E5) | Abort with E-SOURCE-CHANGED |\n| PAUSED | SENDING | Tab foregrounded | Resume frame loop |\n| REPAIR_MODE | SENDING | Repair complete | Return to normal loop |\n| REPAIR_MODE | STOPPING | User cancel | Begin shutdown |\n| STOPPING | IDLE | Cleanup complete | Wipe staging, release resources |\n\n---\n\n## Implementation Guidelines\n\n### Replacing Nullable Fields\n\n**Current problematic pattern (plan.md §7.3):**\n```ts\ntype RecvSession = {\n  streamId: number | null;      // ❌nullable\n  meta: BeaconMeta | null;      // ❌nullable\n  // ...\n}\n```\n\n**Replacement: Explicit states**\n```ts\ntype RecvSessionState =\n  | IdleState\n  | AcquiringState\n  | ReceivingState\n  | VerifyingState\n  | CompleteState\n  | PausedState\n  | RepairWaitingState\n  | RepairTransferringState\n  | QuotaExhaustedState\n  | DecompressFailedState;\n\n// Each state has exact fields, no nulls for core metadata\ntype ReceivingState = {\n  type: 'receiving';\n  streamId: number;           // ✅always present in this state\n  meta: BeaconMeta;           // ✅always present in this state\n  complete: Uint8Array;       // ✅always present\n  writtenBlocks: Uint8Array;  // ✅always present\n  // GE contexts are nullable (between blocks or not yet started)\n  active: {...} | null;           // ✅payload block GE context (null = between blocks)\n  manifestActive: {...} | null;   // ✅manifest block GE context (null = no manifest block)\n  out: FileSystemWritableFileStream | null;  // ✅nullable (OPFS handle)\n  manifest: BlockHashManifest | null;       // ✅nullable (not yet acquired)\n  // ...\n};\n```\n\n### State Machine Enforcement\n\n**Use TypeScript discriminated unions:**\n```ts\nfunction handlePacket(state: RecvSessionState, packet: Packet): RecvSessionState {\n  switch (state.type) {\n    case 'acquiring':\n      // Can't route packets yet\n      return state;\n    case 'receiving':\n      // Normal packet routing\n      return routePacket(state, packet);\n    case 'repair-transferring':\n      // Only accept expected blocks\n      if (state.expectedBlocks.has(packet.blockIndex)) {\n        return handleRepairPacket(state, packet);\n      }\n      return state;\n    // ...\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**Transition validation:**\n```ts\nfunction transition(from: RecvSessionState, to: RecvSessionState): RecvSessionState {\n  // Assert transition is valid\n  assertValidTransition(from.type, to.type);\n\n  // Run exit/entry actions\n  runExitActions(from);\n  const result = runEntryActions(to);\n  return result;\n}\n```\n\n### State Persistence\n\n**Resume token (D22):**\n```ts\ninterface ResumeToken {\n  streamId: number;\n  meta: BeaconMeta;\n  complete: Uint8Array;         // bitmap\n  timestamp: number;\n}\n\n// Only PAUSED and COMPLETE states can be persisted for resume\nfunction canResume(state: RecvSessionState): boolean {\n  return state.type === 'paused' || state.type === 'complete';\n}\n```\n\n### Testing Requirements\n\n**Unit tests:**\n- Every state transition must be tested\n- Invalid transitions must throw\n- State serialization/deserialization for resume\n\n**Integration tests:**\n- Full session lifecycle (IDLE → COMPLETE)\n- All error recovery paths (PAUSED → RECEIVING, E12 re-collect, etc.)\n- Resume flow (D22)\n\n**Property tests:**\n- No forgotten transitions (all nullable field paths covered)\n- State machine is total (no undefined states)\n\n---\n\n## Open Questions & Future Work\n\n1. **D27 duty-cycle integration**: How exactly does duty-cycle trigger PAUSED state?\n   - Proposal: `fps < 0.7 * |\n|-------|-------------|-------|------|\n| **IDLE** | No file selected, no session | App initialization | User selects file |\n| **INITIALIZING_SENDER** | Running pre-flight checks and setup | File (Startup Cleanup)**: Orphaned receiver outputs cleaned on init\n3. **D22 (Resume Disabled with Compression)**: Compression = no resume support\n\n---\n\n## Implementation Status\n\n### ✅ Currently |\n|-------|-------------|-------|------|\n| **IDLE** | No file selected, no session | App initialization | User selects file |\n| **INITIALIZING_SENDER** | Running pre-flight checks and setup | File |\n| **IDLE** (return) | Back to ready state | Cleanup complete | — |\n\n### Async Operations (Planned Sender)\n\n| Operation | Location | Trigger | Completion Signal **Beacon Emission** | Frame loop | Every ~2 seconds | Beacon tile rendered |\n\n### Callback Flow (Planned Sender)\n\n```typescript\n// Entry point: user action\nasync function startSender(file: File): Promise<void> {\n  // ASYNC: Storage pre-flight check\n  const preflight = await checkStoragePreflight(file.size);\n  if (!preflight.sufficient) {\n    showError(preflight.error);\n    return;  // Remain in IDLE\n  }\n  \n  // ASYNC: Compression decision and staging (if enabled)\n  const compression = await sampleCompressibility(file);\n  const staging = compression.enabled \n    ? await compressToOPFS(file) \n    : null;\n  \n  // SYNC: Derive session parameters\n  const params = deriveSessionParams(file, staging);\n  \n  // ASYNC: Compute whole-file hash\n  const wholeFileHash = await computeWholeFileHash(staging || file);\n  \n  // SYNC: Create beacon metadata\n  const beaconMeta = createBeaconMeta(params, wholeFileHash);\n  \n  // SYNC: Initialize sender state\n  const senderState: SendingState = {\n    type: 'sending',\n    source: file,\n    staging,\n    streamId: params.streamId,\n    // ... other fields\n  };\n  \n  // ASYNC: Start frame loop (rAF-driven)\n  startFrameLoop(senderState);\n}\n\n// Frame loop callback\nfunction frameLoop(): void {\n  if (senderState.type !== 'sending') return;\n  \n  // ASYNC: Generate frame on-demand\n  const frame = generateFrame(senderState);\n  \n  // ASYNC: Render frame\n  renderFrame(frame);\n  \n  // CONTINUE: Request next frame\n  requestAnimationFrame(frameLoop);\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## State Transition App Initialization (Current)\n\n1. **DOM First**: No operations before DOM is ready\n2. **Parallel Health**: Health checks and cleanup run concurrently\n3. **Non-blocking**: Initialization doesn't block UI rendering\n4. **Error Tolerant**: Health check failures don't prevent app start\n\n### Sender Initialization (Planned)\n\n1. **I1 (Immutable L)**: Fragment length L is immutable per session\n2. **I3 (Deterministic streamId)**: streamId derived from file identity, not random\n3. **D26 (Conservative K)**: K = 768, assumes weakest receiver\n4. **D25 (Degree Cap)**: Bounded to prevent encode explosion\n5. **D24 (On-demand Frames)**: No pre-rendering, frame N generated when needed\n6. **D9 (Frame Rate Limit)**: ≤½ measured receiver camera fps\n7. **D17 (Beacon Frequency)**: Every ~2 seconds at conservative profile\n8. **I7 (Ring Buffer)**: Depth ≤ 3 frames\n\n### Privacy and Cleanup\n\n1. **T4a (Staging Wipe)**: Staging files wiped on complete/cancel/startup\n2. **E11 (Startup Cleanup)**: Orphaned receiver outputs cleaned on init\n3. **D22 (Resume Disabled with Compression)**: Compression = no resume support\n\n---\n\n## Implementation Status\n\n### ✅ Currently
